title: Israel's 42 Campsites
intro: Numbers 33 records all the places where Israel camped during their wilderness journey from Egypt to Canaan—42 stops over 40 years. This list is a reminder of God's faithful guidance through the desert.

items.title: From Egypt to Sinai (Stops 1–12)
items.text: Rameses → Sukkoth → Etham → Pi Hahiroth → through the Red Sea → Marah → Elim (12 springs, 70 palm trees) → by the Red Sea → Wilderness of Sin → Dophkah → Alush → Rephidim → Wilderness of Sinai

items.title: From Sinai toward Canaan (Stops 13–21)
items.text: Kibroth Hattaavah → Hazeroth → Rithmah → Rimmon Perez → Libnah → Rissah → Kehelathah → Mount Shepher → Haradah

items.title: Years of Wandering (Stops 22–33)
items.text: Makheloth → Tahath → Terah → Mithcah → Hashmonah → Moseroth → Bene Jaakan → Hor Haggidgad → Jotbathah → Abronah → Ezion Geber → Wilderness of Zin (Kadesh)

items.title: Mount Hor
items.text: At the border of Edom, Aaron died at the age of 123. Moses and Eleazar removed his priestly garments and put them on Eleazar.

items.title: Toward the Plains of Moab (Stops 34–42)
items.text: Mount Hor → Zalmonah → Punon → Oboth → Iye Abarim → Dibon Gad → Almon Diblathaim → Mountains of Abarim → Plains of Moab by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth to Abel Shittim.

footer.title: God's Guidance
footer.content: Each camp represents God's faithful care. Even when the people complained and sinned, God never abandoned them. In the same way, our lives are a journey with God leading us step by step toward the Promised Land.
